name: STAR Telemetry — cyclic redundancy checks, bit by bit
summary: The CRC-16 of CCSDS transfer frames, CRC-16/XMODEM, CRC-32, CRC-32C and any Rocksoft-model CRC of 8 to 64 bits computed through the defining shift register; on 499 messages and nine variants identical to fastcrc (4491 values), to CPython binascii and zlib (1497) and to a polynomial division over GF(2) in SymPy (1611); reproduces the nine catalogue check values.
reference: reveng catalogue of parametrised CRC algorithms, check values for 123456789: CRC-16/IBM-3740 0x29B1, CRC-16/XMODEM 0x31C3, CRC-32/ISO-HDLC 0xCBF43926, CRC-32/ISCSI 0xE3069283

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-04: bytes in, int out; the six Rocksoft parameters in their usual order
review.G-06: no external data; cross-check corpus generated with a fixed seed
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO
review.G-13: ValueError for every invalid input; stated that a CRC detects and does not authenticate or correct, and that this is a reference implementation, not a link-rate one
